_: jurassic_park_pro on marty's 'Jurassic Park Limited Edition' 1.0 (cGameName 'jurassic'),
a SCRIPTED original, not a ROM mash-up: Table1_Init calls LoadEM (B2S only) and
nothing reads Controller.Switch/Lamp/Solenoid. Its rules and switch layout come from
an older original (Willy Wonka: tavern, keep, key, rainbow), but its playfield art
and inserts are Stern's JP: every insert light sits within ~30 units of a JP Pro LED
(led_io.txt x*3.06, y*2.75), so the LAMPS are matched by place. The SWITCHES are
matched by role and rough place to the Pro's 34 playfield switches; many are GUESS.
Pro, not LE: the table has no T-Rex mech, no raptor-pit lock, no helicopter opto,
and the LE build carries no LED table at all. It has the Pro's upper right flipper,
three pops and a captive ball by the pops (the Newton ball).
No SolLFlipper/SolRFlipper in this script (it flips inside Table1_KeyDown, gated on
its own game), so `flippers` names PadSol* subs in extra_vbs. The table has a manual
Plunger and no impulse plunger: PadPlungerIM is a small class whose AutoFire does what
the script's own auto-launch does (AutoPlunger, Pullback, Fire).
keylock / tavernlock / keepkicker are the shadow game's ball LOCKS (they hold a ball
until its multiball); the Pro has no coil for them, so their hit subs are quieted and
PadEjectTimer kicks them out every half second (Kick on an empty kicker is a no-op).
K1..K10 and kicktrex are the table's ball TELEPORTERS (destroy here, create there) and
keep their own subs; K2 sits IN the shooter lane (hops the ball over the helicopter).
B2SOn = True is neutered: DOF() would call Controller.B2SSetData, which PAD.Controller
does not have, once the bridge has replaced the B2S.Server Controller.
GI: the table's gi lights are OFF at design time and the JP Pro GI LEDs are unnamed,
so PadEjectTimer calls the table's own GiOn once instead of mapping them.

extra_vbs:
'---- PAD: the machine's flipper coils (this script flips only inside its own game)
Sub PadSolLFlipper(Enabled)
	If Enabled Then
		LeftFlipper.RotateToEnd
		PlaySound SoundFXDOF("fx_flipperup", 101, DOFOn, DOFFlippers), 0, .67, AudioPan(LeftFlipper), 0.05, 0, 0, 1, AudioFade(LeftFlipper)
	Else
		LeftFlipper.RotateToStart
		PlaySound SoundFXDOF("fx_flipperdown", 101, DOFOff, DOFFlippers), 0, 1, AudioPan(LeftFlipper), 0.05, 0, 0, 1, AudioFade(LeftFlipper)
	End If
End Sub
Sub PadSolRFlipper(Enabled)
	If Enabled Then
		RightFlipper.RotateToEnd
		PlaySound SoundFXDOF("fx_flipperup", 102, DOFOn, DOFFlippers), 0, .67, AudioPan(RightFlipper), 0.05, 0, 0, 1, AudioFade(RightFlipper)
	Else
		RightFlipper.RotateToStart
		PlaySound SoundFXDOF("fx_flipperdown", 102, DOFOff, DOFFlippers), 0, 1, AudioPan(RightFlipper), 0.05, 0, 0, 1, AudioFade(RightFlipper)
	End If
End Sub
Sub PadSolURFlipper(Enabled)
	If Enabled Then
		RightFlipper2.RotateToEnd
	Else
		RightFlipper2.RotateToStart
	End If
End Sub

'---- PAD: the auto plunger coil fires the table's own Plunger, the way its auto-launch did
Class PadAutoPlungerC
	Public Sub AutoFire
		Plunger.AutoPlunger = True
		Plunger.Pullback
		Plunger.Fire
		PlaySoundAt "fx_plunger", Plunger
	End Sub
End Class
Dim PadPlungerIM : Set PadPlungerIM = New PadAutoPlungerC

'---- PAD: the shadow game's locks have no coil on the Pro; they hand the ball straight back
Dim PadGiLit : PadGiLit = False
Sub PadEjectTimer_Timer
	keylock.Kick 270, 10
	tavernlock.Kick 180, 20
	keepkicker.Kick 155, 10
	If Not PadGiLit Then
		PadGiLit = True
		GiOn
	End If
End Sub

lamps._: table light -> Spike 2 LEDs [node, index] (several = an RGB insert: lit when any is); matched by PLACE (the art is JP's: led_io.txt x*3.06, y*2.75); GUESS = over ~40 units off or two table lights on one insert
